name: Compute SNR on Corpus Callosum
summary: Computes the signal-to-noise ratio of DWI in the corpus callosum for the b0 and each gradient direction with DIPY, and outputs SNR statistics and the corpus callosum and noise masks.
description: Fits a tensor, segments the corpus callosum from the colour-FA map within a central bounding box (DIPY segment_from_cfa), estimates noise from a background mask (median_otsu) and reports SNR for b0 and for each gradient direction, including the directions closest to x, y and z. Use it as a QC measure of DWI data quality. Follows the DIPY snr_in_cc example.

inputs.description: Diffusion-weighted image with bvals and bvecs.

outputs.description: Raw SNR results (JSON/CSV) and intermediate files.
Corpus callosum mask in DWI space used to measure signal.
Background noise mask in DWI space used to estimate noise.
SNR statistics for b0 and each gradient direction.
